scenarios.name: Invoke an added shortcut while another ribbon tab is active

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
an empty part is active in the MCAD Software
Extrude has been added to the quick access toolbar from 3D Model
the user selects the View ribbon tab
the Extrude quick access icon remains visible
the user selects the Extrude quick access icon
the origin planes are displayed for selection
the origin plane selection display closes
